name: Scattered Gems
description: A fine scatter of dots in a mixed ink palette, sized as a seamless repeating tile.

code.style: --rule: ( background-color: var(--color1); background-image: @doodle( :doodle { @grid: 1 / 10000px; transform: scale(1.5) rotate(45deg); } background-size: 300px 300px; background-image: @doodle( @grid: 1 / 100%; background: @doodle( @grid: @r(8) / 100%; background: @doodle( @grid: @r(10) / 100%; background: radial-gradient( @stripe.@m2.@p( @m(10, (var(--color2))), @m(10, (var(--color1))), @m(2, (var(--color3))), var(--color4) ) ); ); ); ); ); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
